items.text: u\colon A\to B,\qquad \varphi\colon X=\operatorname{Spec}B\to Y=\operatorname{Spec}A,\qquad \varphi(\mathfrak p)=u^{-1}(\mathfrak p)

$\varphi$ is a morphism of ringed spaces and $u=\Gamma(\varphi)\colon\Gamma(Y,\mathcal O_Y)\to\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$. $\operatorname{Hom}_{\text{rings}}(A,B)\hookrightarrow\operatorname{Hom}_{\text{ringed}}(X,Y)$.
Direct image $\leftrightarrow$ restriction of scalars; inverse image $\leftrightarrow$ extension of scalars.
$\varphi(x)=y$ gives $\mathcal O_{Y,y}\to\mathcal O_{X,x}$. A homomorphism $u\colon\mathcal O\to\mathcal O'$ of local rings is local if
u^{-1}(\mathfrak m')=\mathfrak m\iff u(\mathfrak m)\subset\mathfrak m'\iff\bigl(f\in\mathcal O^*\Leftrightarrow u(f)\in\mathcal O'^*\bigr)
A morphism of ringed spaces is a morphism of locally ringed spaces if all the maps on stalks are local.
